prompts.prompt: By default, how many ports does GCP Cloud NAT allocate per VM instance for outbound connections? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/gcp-vpc/SKILL.md - Cloud NAT default port allocation is 64 ports per VM

prompts.prompt: On GCP, what is the throughput cap of a single HA VPN tunnel? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/gcp-vpc/SKILL.md - each HA VPN tunnel supports up to 3 Gbps

prompts.prompt: Does a Google Cloud VPC network span a single region only, or does it span all regions globally by default? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/gcp-vpc/SKILL.md - GCP VPC is global by default, a single VPC spans all regions simultaneously
